5.6.20 Rte_IWrite Purpose: Provide write access to the VariableDataPrototypes referenced by VariableAccesses in the dataWriteAccess role. Signature: [SWS_Rte_03744] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_Rte_00129 ⌈ void Rte_[Byps_]IWrite__

_( [IN Rte_Instance ], IN , [IN Std_TransformerForwardCode forwardedCode], [IN uint8* metaDataPtr]) Where is the short name of the RunnableEntity,

the port name and the VariableDataPrototype short name. [Byps_] is an optional infix used when component wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type.⌋ Existence: [SWS_Rte_01302] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051 ⌈An Rte_IWrite API shall be created for a provided Variable- DataPrototype if the RunnableEntity has a VariableAccess in the dataWriteAccess role referring to this VariableDataPro- totype.⌋ [SWS_Rte_CONSTR_09084] Rte_IWrite API may only be used by the runnable that describe its usage ⌈The Rte_IWrite API may only be used by the runnable that contains the corresponding VariableAccess in the dataWriteAccess role.⌋ Description: The Rte_IWrite API provides write access to the VariableDat- aPrototypes declared as accessed by a runnable using Vari- ableAccesses in the dataWriteAccess role. The API function is guaranteed to be have constant execution time and therefore can also be used within category 1A runnable entities.
